title: Affine blowup chart presentation for a regular sequence
statement: Let $R$ be a ring and let $a,a_2,\ldots,a_s$ be a regular sequence [def-weil-pbc-regular-sequence]. Put $I=(a,a_2,\ldots,a_s)$ and let $R[I/a]$ be the affine blowup chart [def-nagata-blowup-chart-ring]. Then $R[I/a]$ is canonically isomorphic to $R[y_2,\ldots,y_s]/(a y_i-a_i\mid 2\le i\le s)$, with $y_i$ corresponding to $a_i/a$.
